hooks.command: node -e "const p=process.argv[1]; if(p&&p.includes('/console/')) require('child_process').execSync('cd console && pnpm prettier --write "+p+" 2>/dev/null',{stdio:'ignore'}); if(p&&p.includes('/management/')) require('child_process').execSync('cd management && pnpm prettier --write "+p+" 2>/dev/null',{stdio:'ignore'});" "$FILE_PATH"
